notes: All 28 listed sheets were opened, some through 2×2 private temporary comparison boards, and their actual photo thumbnails observed. The individual source attribution metadata and original contact image files remain in private recovered five-ZIP archive, not the public repo.

One of 28 is historical Coelorachis cylindrica, currently staged as Rottboellia campestris under Kew. ITIS accepts the alternative combination Mnesithea cylindrica. This is one source sheet for the same existing provisional candidate.

One of 28 is Elymus glabriflorus historically identified, collapsed to existing Elymus virginicus by current Kew policy. It MUST NOT be treated as proof for a separate Elymus macgregorii candidate or added to count.
Scientific names and characters derive from existing Hays staged literature packets; observations below are visually seen features, not inferred botanical species identity.
No original high-resolution photographs were downloaded or publicly rehosted. CC BY-NC distribution restricted to private botany review; current exact photo licenses not reverified.

The full 317 tiles are now examined at contact-sheet level, not the 317 original full-resolution specimen files. Fine-scale glume, lemma, floret and ligule microscopy remains incomplete, so zero admissions.
